title: Understanding the DataFrame
text: The DataFrame 'consoles' contains information about video game consoles, including their type, sales, and other attributes. We need to find the best-selling console for each type: home and handheld.

title: Sorting the DataFrame
text: To find the best-selling consoles, we need to sort the DataFrame by the 'sales' column. This will help us identify the console with the highest sales for each type.

title: Grouping by Console Type
text: After sorting, we need to group the DataFrame by the 'type' column. This will allow us to separate the home consoles from the handheld consoles.

title: Selecting the Best-Selling Console
text: Once the DataFrame is sorted and grouped, we can select the last entry in each group to get the best-selling console for each type.

title: Write the Code
text: Combine the steps to write a single line of code that sorts the DataFrame by sales, groups by type, and selects the last entry in each group.
